title: Set computer name
summary: Change the friendly name of your Mac as it appears on the network.

steps.explain: Use scutil with sudo to set a new ComputerName. This name is used for network sharing.

placeholders.name: COMPUTER_NAME
placeholders.description: The new friendly name for your Mac

rollback.explain: Set the ComputerName back to its original value.

placeholders.name: OLD_COMPUTER_NAME
placeholders.description: The previous name of the computer

warnings: Changing the computer name may affect how other devices see your Mac on the network.
